newsitem.title: GREECE: EARLY MORNING QUAKE SHAKES ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: EARLY MORNING QUAKE SHAKES ATHENS.

text.p: A strong earthquake registering 4.9 on the Richter scale shook Athens this morning at 0817 local time. No damage or injuries have been reported.

Seismologists at the Athens Geodynamics Institute said the epicentre of the quake was in the sea region off the Sporades island of Alonissos, 150 km north-northeast of Athens, an area not noted for its seismic activity.
